nodes.name: Voice Webhook
nodes.notes: Twilio voice webhook. Forward mode texts the caller in this response. Dial mode rings the owner, then mctb-dial-status sends the text.

nodes.name: Normalize Voice
nodes.notes: Reads Twilio form fields. Honors body.now only when TWILIO_MODE is not live.

nodes.name: Load Voice Context
nodes.notes: Loads the tenant for this Twilio number. Phones are already normalized, so they contain no commas.

nodes.name: Decide Voice
nodes.notes: Chooses forward-mode text-back or a Dial to the owner phone.

nodes.name: Save Voice
nodes.notes: Skip the database write when the caller is unknown or this call was already handled.

nodes.name: Apply Voice
nodes.notes: One JSON parameter. n8n binds a JSON string as a single value, so commas inside the payload are safe.

nodes.name: Prepare Voice Response
nodes.notes: TwiML is the Twilio response. Customer and owner texts in that XML are sent by Twilio itself.

nodes.name: Notify On Voice
nodes.notes: Optional fan-out when OWNER_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is set.

nodes.name: Post Voice Alert
nodes.notes: Posts the owner alert to OWNER_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (Discord, the existing CloudOS owner-notify webhook, or an email gateway). Failure does not change the TwiML response.
